AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION

CALL TO ORDER Mayor Lainez called the meeting to order at 5:16 p.m.

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS There were no individuals wishing to address the City Council on any Closed Session items.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION The members of the City Council and Successor Agency recessed to Closed Session at 5:17 p.m.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION The members of the City Council and Successor Agency reconvened to open session at 6:07 p.m.

ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT City Attorney Tapia reported on Closed Session Item No. 1, stating that with the entire Council present, one (1) potential litigation matter was discussed. Staff provided a presentation, the Council gave direction, and no final reportable action was taken. 

ADJOURNMENT Mayor Lainez adjourned the meeting at 6:08 p.m.
